components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #eeeeef; color: #090a0f; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 12px; border: none; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(255,255,255,0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #eeeeef; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); background: rgba(29, 33, 48, 0.35); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

narrative.overview: Twilight DeFi is a high-contrast, premium, dark-mode visual interface designed to evoke a sense of calm, precision, and verifiability. By stripping away typical DeFi tropes—such as neon colors, flashing green/red tags, and confusing charts—the interface establishes trust through typographic hierarchy and structural clarity.
keyCharacteristics: Strict grayscale visual discipline (all structural states, directions, and values are monochrome).
A single warm-white accent (#f5f3ee) reserved exclusively for the moon and its halo.
Tactile, high-end transitions using a custom exponential ease-out curve.
Complete on-chain transparency (never show a number that is not live-fetched).

rules.name: The Grayscale Discipline Rule
rules.body: No green or red is ever used to indicate direction or status. Up/down movements are indicated solely via directional glyphs (↑ or ↓) and typography weights.

rules.name: The Display Serif Isolation Rule
rules.body: The serif typeface must only appear on the primary hero balance value inside the moon disc. Every other number and text label uses the sans-serif geometric face.

dos: Do align columns of numbers using the tnum class.
Do use the custom cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) easing curve for all state transitions.
Do provide clear, descriptive empty states that guide the user on their next steps.
donts: Don't use the warm-white glow color (#f5f3ee) on buttons, labels, active borders, or focus outlines.
Don't use any green or red colors for gain, loss, success, or error status messages.
Don't use monospaced fonts for anything other than transaction hashes or code elements.
